decisions.decision: The BOS assigned four action items to the OS Committee: (1) a list of priority criteria for conservation value of available and potentially available properties, including Chapter 61 lands and tax title/town-owned land; (2) a policy and town process for responding to rights of first refusal on Chapter 61 lands; (3) updates in the next OS plan on sewer expansion, population growth against wastewater plan numbers, and stress on the Mulpus and Catacunamoug water source basins; (4) placing the OS plan in its own directory on the town web site.
decisions.quote: the bos assigned 4 action items to the os committee:

decisions.decision: The BOS requested that the Town Manager copy the OS Committee on Chapter 61 ROFR notices when the BOS is notified.

decisions.decision: The next iteration of the OS plan will be after 2014, and the listed factors will be considered at that time.
